records.Concise description: Bitcoin P2P discovery and private messaging app built around friends and friends-of-friends rather than platform escrow.
records.Deeper researched summary: Vexl works as a private marketplace and social-graph coordination layer. Users discover offers from trusted-network connections, chat anonymously, agree terms and then meet or otherwise settle directly. Vexl's current site says it never handles users' money or tracks purchases. Because the app does not provide an escrow that guarantees performance, counterparty and settlement risk are handled socially and by the users themselves.
Creators / founders: Vexl founding team / open-source project contributors
records.Launch / history: Vexl launched in the early 2020s as a privacy-focused Bitcoin P2P app built around contact-derived social graphs.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: It shows a different way to decentralize exchange coordination: not by multisig or Lightning escrow, but by reducing strangers through a private trust network.
Important technical or cultural characte: No KYC in core marketplace flow
records.Verification basis: Current Vexl first-party site verifies active app operation, social-graph discovery, anonymous chat and the statement that Vexl never handles users' money.
Research notes / uncertainties: Vexl does not escrow trade funds; do not imply the app guarantees settlement.
No-KYC positioning does not mean every external fiat payment method is anonymous or legally available everywhere.

records.Concise description: Bitcoin-centered derivatives exchange launched in 2014 that remains operating on the verification date but has announced a September 23, 2026 closure.
records.Deeper researched summary: BitMEX pioneered high-leverage crypto derivatives and the perpetual-swap model around Bitcoin. It remains an operating custodial trading venue as of August 15, 2026, but on July 23 announced that the exchange will close September 23, 2026 at 04:00 UTC. New registrations stopped immediately; risk limits are scheduled from August 26 and positions will be wound down before closure. Lifecycle is therefore ACTIVE on the record date, with a mandatory near-term recheck.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2014 as a professional-grade crypto derivatives venue. On July 23, 2026, operator HDR Global Trading Limited announced closure effective September 23, 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: BitMEX profoundly influenced Bitcoin derivatives market structure through leveraged perpetual swaps and global crypto-native futures trading.
records.Verification basis: BitMEX's live exchange and July 23, 2026 first-party closure announcement verify present operation and the scheduled wind-down timeline.
Research notes / uncertainties: HIGH-PRIORITY PUBLICATION CAUTION: lifecycle is ACTIVE only because verification occurred on 2026-08-15, before the announced closure. Reclassify after closure or if operations change earlier.
Any historical enforcement discussion should distinguish company cases from founder-level cases and be separately sourced.

records.Entity / project type: Institutional custodial spot exchange / OTC venue
records.Concise description: Retired New York trust-chartered Bitcoin exchange lineage operated by Paxos, historically important to regulated institutional spot and OTC trading.
records.Deeper researched summary: itBit became the first virtual-currency company to receive a New York limited-purpose trust charter in May 2015 and later became part of the Paxos corporate lineage. Paxos retired the itBit trading platform effective August 9, 2026. Paxos continues separate brokerage/order-routing infrastructure, but that successor functionality does not make the retired itBit venue ACTIVE. The canonical record therefore preserves itBit's regulated institutional exchange history while treating current Paxos brokerage as related lineage.
Creators / founders: Charles Cascarilla — co-founder of itBit/Paxos lineage
records.Launch / history: itBit launched in 2013 and received a New York trust charter in 2015. The corporate lineage became Paxos; retail access had already been deprecated, and Paxos retired the itBit trading platform effective August 9, 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: It was a milestone in the transition from early Bitcoin exchanges to regulated trust-company and institutional execution infrastructure in New York.
Important technical or cultural characte: Current Paxos brokerage/order-routing infrastructure is successor/related functionality, not the retired venue
records.Verification basis: Paxos's current itBit page states the platform was retired effective 2026-08-09; NYDFS primary material verifies the 2015 trust charter and commercial Bitcoin-exchange history.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not describe itBit as currently active: Paxos says the trading platform was retired effective 2026-08-09.
Paxos brokerage and order-routing infrastructure continues separately and should be treated as related successor functionality rather than reactivating the itBit lifecycle.

records.Concise description: CME Group's regulated cash-settled Bitcoin futures complex, a major bridge between Bitcoin price exposure and traditional derivatives markets.
records.Deeper researched summary: CME launched its first Bitcoin futures contract in December 2017. The contracts are cash-settled rather than delivering on-chain bitcoin and reference CME CF benchmark rates. CME later added options, micro contracts, Bitcoin Friday Futures and in May 2026 moved crypto futures/options trading to a 24/7 schedule. Because settlement is in cash, this profile must not be described as a custodial BTC exchange or an on-chain purchase venue.
Creators / founders: CME CF benchmarks — benchmark partnership lineage
records.Launch / history: Bitcoin futures launched in December 2017; the product family later expanded with options, Micro Bitcoin futures and Bitcoin Friday Futures. CME crypto derivatives moved to continuous 24/7 trading in 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: It brought Bitcoin price exposure and hedging into established U.S. futures-market infrastructure and became important to institutional price discovery without requiring spot BTC custody.
Important technical or cultural characte: No delivery of on-chain BTC through the futures contract
records.Verification basis: Current CME product/education material verifies active cash-settled Bitcoin futures and benchmark-based structure.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not say CME Bitcoin futures deliver bitcoin or give traders custody of BTC; the contracts are cash-settled.
Contract specs and trading schedules are time-sensitive and should be rechecked before publication.
